tools.name: ehr_fhir_lookup
tools.description: Look up a patient's FHIR record (demographics + recent Observations) from the governed EHR. Clinical PHI — restricted to clinical staff.

patientId.description: FHIR Patient logical id (e.g. sterling-4870292 or halo-er-chestpain)

tools.name: imaging_lookup
tools.description: Look up a patient's imaging studies (FHIR ImagingStudy) from the governed EHR. Clinical PHI — restricted to clinical staff.

patientId.description: FHIR Patient logical id whose ImagingStudy resources to return
